simple: A SIEM for the security operations center (SOC) running on the Splunk data platform — in your own data center (Splunk Enterprise) or as a cloud service (Splunk Cloud Platform). Collects and normalizes logs from any source (2,800+ apps and add-ons on Splunkbase) and searches and analyzes them with the SPL query language. Comes with 1,700+ ready-made detections from Splunk Threat Research mapped to MITRE ATT&CK; Detection Studio helps test, deploy and monitor your own detections and see gaps in ATT&CK coverage. Risk-Based Alerting collects small signals per user or computer and raises a single alert once the risk adds up — up to 90% fewer alerts (vendor data). Built-in Threat Intelligence Management pulls in indicator feeds and matches them against events. Exposure Analytics continuously discovers computers, users, IP and MAC addresses in the logs and builds an up-to-date asset inventory from them. Investigation, case management and response plans are in one workspace; the AI assistant answers questions, writes queries and summarizes incidents (in the cloud, where available). Response automation (SOAR), user behavior analytics (UEBA), automated analysis of malicious files and links, and AI agents are only in the Premier edition.
